watch_pct_definition: 100 * average_watch_time_seconds / video_duration_seconds; replay-inclusive average watch can exceed 100%.
baseline_definition: Fitted views for each account at watch_pct=50 and skip_pct=50.
validation_method: Outer leave-one-reel-out; ridge strength selected by inner leave-one-reel-out separately in each fold. Each candidate feature set is evaluated separately; final model choice remains exploratory.
limits: Only 19 or fewer aligned reels and four accounts, with two accounts represented by only two reels.
Retrospective metrics on completed reels do not establish early-post forecasting performance.
Account-based predictions apply to the represented accounts, not automatically to a new account.
View counts, rate cards and retention have different measurement conventions; some source counts are rounded.
The stats model improves root-mean-square log error over an account-only baseline, but has worse median error.
The selected feature set and model family were compared on the same small dataset; validation is exploratory, not an independent prospective test.
